rules_satisfied: Holzman Safety: No production unsafe/unwrap/expect/panic/todo/unimplemented/unreachable/unchecked indexing/lossy as
Holzman Allocation: No bounded Vec constructions requiring try_reserve (no heap allocation in core)
Holzman Arithmetic: checked_add for total accumulation, checked_div for average division
Holzman Casts: try_from for count u64->u32 width-reducing cast
Holzman Parsing: split_once used instead of split+collect+indexing
Functional Core: Pure deterministic summarize_metrics returning domain type; render_summary as pure formatter
Type safety: Result<Summary, SummaryError> instead of Result<String, SummaryError>

Tests are the immutable behavior contract - no test files edited
residual_risk: Minimal. The count as usize cast on 64-bit linux is lossless (usize==u64). No external I/O in core. All error paths return typed domain errors.
